EC50_MICROM: Effective concentration of half maximal binding of fluorescent ligand as estimated by curve fit
EC50_95CI_LOW: Lower 95% confidence interval boundary for the EC50 curve fit estimate
EC50_95CI_HIGH: Upper 95% confidence interval boundary for the EC50 curve fit estimate
HILLSLOPE: Hill slope estimate for the fitted dose response curve or set at 1
RSQR: Correlation coefficient for the fitted dose response curve
N_POINTS: Number of data points for each dose response curve with at least 2 replicates per concentration
RESPONSE_100.0_MICROM (100.0uM): Average percent binding of fluorescent ligand at 100.0 micromolar concentration of test compound
